## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [ ] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [ ] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [ ] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [ ] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [ ] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
